nexu-io-openmotion-library-brandkit.description: Prepare a reusable Brandkit and motion-design brief from user-supplied brand facts, assets and references. Use when organizing brand context for a video, not for rendering or editing a project.

nexu-io-openmotion-library-motion-design.description: Adapt one of six bundled motion compositions using its MOTION_DESIGN.md, preserving timing and movement while replacing the user's copy. Use for these source-backed examples or as a concrete pattern for a reusable motion design package.

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-director.description: Plan and create original motion videos and motion graphics with OpenMotion. Use for “做一个 motion 视频”、动效视频、动画短片、先构思视频怎么呈现, including esports recaps, explainers, product demos and brand films. Also use for narrative, motion or sound redesign and creative review. Execute established edits/exports with motion-production, editable templates with motion-template-to-video, reference reconstruction with motion-recreate and reusable templates with motion-video-to-template. Repository development does not trigger video production.

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-production.description: 执行 OpenMotion 已有工程在既定创作决定下的局部修改、素材或音轨替换、预览、技术排错、导出与交付。重新设计叙事、动作或声画关系使用 motion-director；已有模板出片走 motion-template-to-video，参考作品复刻走 motion-recreate，视频转可复用模板走 motion-video-to-template。仓库开发与文档维护不触发影片制作。

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-recreate.description: Recreate a reference video (a link or file) as the user's own Motion film: rebuild it as an editable OpenMotion project and hand it over open in the editor, keeping the original content or swapping in the user's copy, brand and assets. This includes small edits to the user's own finished video when no editable project for it exists. "Make one like this" and "I want this feel" both count as recreation. In a workspace with the user's product material, a bare link alone means "make one like this for us". Not for only analysing or discussing a video. Use motion-director when the reference is only…

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-template-to-vi.description: 使用已有可编辑 Motion 模板、工程文件夹、ZIP 或已选画廊源码出片，原样交付或替换文案、品牌与素材，保留约定结构和动效。包含已接受的首次体验；续作沿用当前工程。只有参考成片而无可编辑模板时走 motion-recreate，视频转可复用模板走 motion-video-to-template，原创走 motion-director。

nexu-io-openmotion-motion-video-to-templ.description: 将参考 Motion 视频或链接重建为可反复换内容的可编辑模板，交付源码、素材、预览、编辑说明与文件夹或 ZIP。仅在用户要求可复用模板时使用；按参考制作本次成片走 motion-recreate，使用已有模板出片或替换内容走 motion-template-to-video，原创走 motion-director。

nexu-io-openmotion-library-presenter-sto.description: Adapt presenter-led videos using reusable motion design recipes for listicles, workflow demonstrations and product walkthroughs. Use with the creator's own footage and measured speech timing to combine spoken storytelling, captions, screen recordings and motion.

nexu-io-openmotion-reference-video.description: OpenMotion 原生 Hyperframes 编写的兼容入口，供旧引用继续使用。新的视频任务按本轮意图进入相应专业 Skill，工程操作复用 motion-production；本入口不承担专门的视频复刻分析。
